blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Paris-based banking group BNP Paribas is setting up a Philippine delivery center to support its global corporate and institutional banking business. On Monday, Megaworld disclosed to the local bourse that BNP Paribas Solutions Philippines would occupy office space in Uptown Eastgate, adding another multinational tenant to its office portfolio. The facility will support the banking group’s global shared services.
